knownLimitations.note: The keyword blocklist is a first-pass filter. Borderline content (gore, gambling) passes to Claude's own safety guardrails. This is intentional and documented.
Template keyword matching is English-only. Non-English prompts always fall through to freeform (no scaffold). Claude handles them correctly but loses template structure benefits.
Prompts like "a game with no graphics" may result in Claude returning < 3 assets. Server-side validateManifest warns but does not pad — the game runs with primitive placeholders.

fixesApplied.description: New module: validatePromptLength, filterContent, scanLuaScript, validateManifest, detectSystemPromptLeak

Pre-generation validation (length + content filter) runs before DB insert. Post-generation script scan + manifest hard-validation replace old warn-only checks. Template scores logged on every generation.
Added scoreTemplates() export for observability and testing.
